name: synthetic_alarm_protocol_readiness

dataset.generator: For each synthetic sequence, x(t) = 0.5 + 0.4*sin(2*pi*t/20 + phase_rad); this file declares the recipe only.

task.target: indicator that synthetic x(t+1) is at least 0.7

representation.name: finite_history
representation.availability_rule: Use only x(t) available at the prediction time t.

policy.information_set: current synthetic sample available at prediction time
policy.decision_rule: Predict positive when the persistence score x(t) is at least 0.7; otherwise predict negative.

split.strategy: prespecified temporal held-out test within each synthetic sequence
split.interval_convention: Left inclusive and right exclusive; retain a prediction only when its one-second target time is inside the same partition.
split.fit_policy: No fitting or threshold selection; the model and threshold are fixed before any test evaluation.

intended_use: Freeze a synthetic threshold-alarm protocol for configuration-readiness demonstrations; no patient diagnosis or treatment use.
population: Four analytic synthetic sequences sim-01 through sim-04 with the phases specified in the dataset recipe; no human participants.
data_provenance: Analytic sinusoidal recipe declared in this configuration; samples have not been generated or acquired and no external cohort is represented.
inclusion_exclusion: Include integer-second predictions with finite current samples and an available one-second target within the same temporal partition; exclude boundary-crossing or missing-target predictions.
reference_standard: Binary labels would be computed directly from the declared analytic x(t+1) >= 0.7 rule, independently of the persistence prediction; no clinician adjudication is claimed.
endpoint: Synthetic signal threshold exceedance one second after the prediction time; this is not a clinical event.
analysis_population: All eligible predictions in the prespecified temporal test partition across the four synthetic sequences; repeated observations belong to their sequence.
missing_data: The analytic recipe defines complete values; if a current sample is unavailable the policy abstains, and if a target is unavailable the prediction is excluded and counted explicitly without imputation.

model.name: analytic_persistence_score
model.prediction_rule: The one-second-ahead signal score equals the current sample x(t).
model.calibration: Signal score only; no calibrated probability claim.
